svg.title: Kelvo — Your databases. One query gateway.
svg.desc: A small red Kelvo symbol and black serif wordmark sit above a warm-white database grid. PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, DuckDB, ClickHouse, Snowflake, Databricks and Elasticsearch surround the heading. Native execution. DuckDB federation. Arrow results.

defs.title: Database product marks used in the Kelvo banner
defs.desc: Eight reusable SVG symbols. Attribution and upstream licenses: database-marks.SOURCES.md. Product names and marks belong to their owners; no endorsement is implied.
